headline: CoreWeave Market Confidence Erodings as Bond Yields Spike and Stock Sinks
summary: CoreWeave shares are down 29% in October, and the spreads in its credit default swaps are widening amid spiking bond yields.
why: As a prominent cloud infrastructure provider scaling rapidly to support artificial intelligence workloads, changes in CoreWeave's financing costs signal shifting sentiment toward capital-intensive tech sectors.

impacts.name: Technology Infrastructure
impacts.why: Widening credit default swaps and falling equity prices reflect tightening credit conditions for high-growth tech firms.

why_moved: Spiking bond yields increase borrowing costs for debt-reliant high-growth tech enterprises, eroding investor confidence.
